name: Data Analyst
description: Clean, query and communicate evidence from structured data.
project: Analyze a public retail dataset with SQL and Pandas. Build a Power BI dashboard and explain three business findings with data-quality checks.

name: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Develop evaluated models and deliver them through reliable services.
project: Train a reproducible classifier with a held-out evaluation, serve predictions through FastAPI, and containerize the tested service.

name: AI Engineer
description: Build applications that combine neural models, language models and retrieval.
project: Build a grounded question-answering service over public documents. Track retrieval quality and unsupported-answer cases, and expose a validated API.

name: NLP Engineer
description: Build and evaluate systems that understand and process text.
project: Compare a TF-IDF text classifier with a small transformer on a public labelled dataset. Report per-class metrics and error analysis.

name: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Process images and evaluate classification or detection systems.
project: Evaluate an object detector on a consented public image dataset. Document per-class metrics, lighting failures and a reproducible inference demo.

name: Data Scientist
description: Use statistics and models to investigate problems and evaluate evidence.
project: Analyze a public tabular dataset, define a business question, compare a baseline with a trained model, and communicate uncertainty and limitations.

name: Python Developer
description: Develop maintainable Python applications and automated tests.
project: Build a Python command-line application backed by SQLite. Add typed functions, meaningful tests and a documented installation process.

name: Backend Developer
description: Design data-backed APIs with validation, tests and reliable deployment.
project: Build a CRUD service with schema validation, transactions and access-control tests. Containerize it and document error responses.

name: Generative AI Engineer
description: Design grounded language-model applications and measure output quality.
project: Create a grounded document assistant with a retrieval evaluation set. Compare prompt variants, check citations, and record unsupported questions.

name: LLM Engineer
description: Adapt, evaluate and serve language models with reproducible experiments.
project: Evaluate a small open language model on a fixed task. Compare an adaptation with the base model and document data provenance, metrics and serving constraints.

name: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Build trusted business metrics and interactive reporting dashboards.
project: Build a small dimensional model and a Power BI report. Validate measures against SQL totals and document metric definitions and refresh steps.

name: Data Engineer
description: Build validated pipelines and reliable analytical data stores.
project: Build an idempotent public-data pipeline with schema checks, staged transformations and a small warehouse. Add recovery and duplicate-event tests.

name: MLOps Engineer
description: Make model delivery, tracking and monitoring reproducible and reliable.
project: Build a small training-to-serving pipeline with versioned artifacts, CI tests, health checks, and a documented model rollback procedure.
